## Documentation generated by Dosu, some manual changes

LaTeX OCR with Llama 3.2 Vision is a Streamlit application that extracts LaTeX code from images containing mathematical equations using the Llama 3.2 Vision model. The app enables users to upload images (PNG, JPG, JPEG) and receive the corresponding LaTeX code, which is also rendered for visual verification. The extraction process leverages the `ollama.chat` API and applies post-processing to clean and deduplicate the output before display. The interface provides a sidebar for image upload and extraction controls, a clear button to reset results, and a footer with credits and a link to report issues on GitHub. The app is configured with a custom page title, icon, and wide layout for usability [[source]](https://github.com/Daidanny008/OllamaVisionLaTeX/blob/19c4e5b06a70d12304eefaa7e26198fb3b90a3b9/app.py#L7-L107).

## Features

- Upload images containing mathematical equations.
- Extract LaTeX code from images using the Llama 3.2 Vision model via the Ollama API.
- Clean and deduplicate LaTeX output, removing hallucinated lines and extraneous dollar signs.
- Render the extracted LaTeX code for visual confirmation.
- Clear results and reset the interface with a single click.
- Sidebar controls for image upload and extraction.
- Footer with credits and a link to report issues.

## Requirements

- Python (compatible with Streamlit)
- Streamlit
- PIL (Python Imaging Library)
- Ollama Python client (`ollama`)
- Access to the `llama3.2-vision` model via the Ollama API

## Installation

1. Install dependencies:
   ```
   pip install streamlit pillow ollama
   ```
2. Ensure you have access to the `llama3.2-vision` model via the Ollama API.
3. Run ollama in one terminal
   ```
   ollama serve
   ```

5. Run the application in another terminal:
   ```
   streamlit run app.py
   ```

## Usage

1. Launch the app locally with Streamlit.
2. Use the sidebar to upload an image file (PNG, JPG, or JPEG) containing a mathematical equation.
3. Click "Extract LaTeX" to process the image.
4. View the extracted LaTeX code and its rendered output in the main area.
5. Use the "Clear" button to reset the result and upload a new image if desired.

## Configuration

The app is configured with a wide layout and an expanded sidebar for ease of use. No additional configuration is required beyond API access and dependencies.

## Reporting Issues

To report bugs or request features, use the "Report an Issue" link in the app footer or visit the [GitHub issues page](https://github.com/patchy631/ai-engineering-hub/issues) [[source]](https://github.com/Daidanny008/OllamaVisionLaTeX/blob/19c4e5b06a70d12304eefaa7e26198fb3b90a3b9/app.py#L7-L107).
